env.up: v=0 is up (zenith), v=0.5 horizon, v=1 nadir
env.dir_to_uv: camera space d (x right, y up, z towards viewer): u = 0.5 + atan2(d.x, -d.z) / (2*pi), v = 0.5 - asin(d.y) / pi
env.origin: bubble position, 1.2 m in front of the camera, 12 cm above the lens axis; same orientation as the main camera

color: sRGB display-referred (Blender AgX view transform baked in); backlit park at sunset
note: Golden hour v2: the low sun (7 deg up, 2 deg left of the lens axis) glows through the trees, upper-left; 'sun_dir' points from the bubble towards it in camera space. In env.jpg the sun is only a small hot core (~0.6 deg, a few clipped pixels) with a modest amber halo: use a small, tight, warm highlight. The sky runs amber-peach at the horizon to cream and a soft dusty blue overhead; the tree ring fades into warm haze towards the sun and blue-lilac haze behind the camera; the lawn is in shade.
